newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS, ASK NZ TO BAT IN TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS, ASK NZ TO BAT IN TEST.

text.p: Sri Lanka won the toss and asked New Zealand to bat in the first test starting in Dunedin on Friday.
Sri Lanka left out off-spinner Kumar Dharmasena from their 12, giving a test debut to 18-year-old left-arm fast bowler Nuwan Zoysa. Zoysa was playing at schoolboy level only eight months ago.

New Zealand suffered a late setback when fast bowler Geoff Allott withdrew from the side. He pulled up with back pain at training on Thursday but X-rays have failed to diagnose the extent of his problem.
New Zealand: Stephen Fleming (captain), Blair Pocock, Bryan Young, Matt Horne, Nathan Astle, Chris Cairns, Adam Parore, Dipak Patel, Daniel Vettori, Heath Davis, Simon Doull

Sri Lanka: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Roshan Mahanama, Sanath Jayasuriya, Marvan Atapattu, Aravinda de Silva, Hashan Tillekaratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Muttiah Muralitharan, Chaminda Vaas, Pramodya Wickremasinghe, Nuwan Zoysa
